title: Operator DB migration triggered reconcile deadlock and tenant lockup — hotpatch and runbook
creator: Maya Thompson
description: During a staged operator upgrade in several Private/VPC clusters, a bundled Postgres migration job modified CR annotation keys and briefly held a cluster-scoped lock. The operator's reconcile loop attempted to apply a tenant-level write while the migration held an exclusive DB transaction and an ephemeral annotation seal, causing controller goroutines to block and leader-election to lose quorum on a subset of nodes. Result: multiple customer tenants reported failed rollout states, worker nodeagent crashes, and stalled token refreshes. This ticket tracks the emergency hotpatch, on-cluster remediation scripts, and the post-incident runbook to prevent recurrence.
acceptance_criteria: Operator release includes safe preflight migration check that will not run DB migrations if nodeagent/kv cache is not healthy
Helm upgrade installs a pre-upgrade backup hook and a migration job with a short-lived pessimistic lock and a configurable timeout
Automated onprem remediation script can detect and clear the reconcile deadlock without data loss
Canary rollout of hotfix shows no reconcile stalls across 3 Private regions for 24h
Customer-facing escalations closed with documented follow-ups and timeline
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Install operator v3.4.0 on an isolated Private cluster with a tenant containing medium-sized model snapshots and active KV cache
2) Trigger an operator upgrade that includes the DB migration job (migration increments schema version from 17 -> 18),
3) Simulate slow DB I/O (throttle Postgres by 200ms p99) while also causing nodeagent to briefly restart (kill nodeagent pod),
4) Observe operator migration job acquiring exclusive DB transaction and writing ephemeral annotation 'redwood/operator-migration:in-progress',
5) Confirm controller watchdog goroutines block on CR update waits and leader-election transitions causing reconciliation for certain namespaces to stall
mitigation_actions: Applied cluster-scoped emergency script (scripts/clear-reconcile-lock.sh) to remove ephemeral annotations and restart operator leader-election without rollback
Scaled down migration job to run sequentially with a 30s lock TTL and forced timeout
Opened customer tickets and notified impacted tenants with next steps and expected time to resolution
Rolled operator back to v3.3.9 on two critical clusters where hotpatch rollback was safer than forward-fix
Prepared hotfix branch and alpha helm chart that adds preflight and shorter migration lock TTL
implementation_notes: Add preflight health-check: verify nodeagent Ready count >= 90% and kv-cache reports <= 5% eviction in last 10m
Migration job: add idempotency and --timeout flag default 60s plus exponential backoff for DB lock acquisition
Operator: add leader-election fallback that allows another instance to attempt reconcile if primary is stuck for >45s
Informer resync: increase default resyncPeriod for tenant CR informer from 10m to 2m during upgrade window
Helm: introduce pre-upgrade hook to snapshot tenant CRs to ConfigMap and post-upgrade hook to validate parity
Add telemetry: emit event redwood.operator.migration.lock_acquired with migration_id and nodehost for tracing
rollout_plan: 1) Cut hotfix release operator-3.4.1-hotfix and publish helm chart operator-chart-3.4.1-hotfix.tgz to internal registry
2) Canary install in Private region eu-west-2 on 2 non-production tenants (low-risk), monitor 4h
3) If stable, expand to 5 production tenants in eu-west-2 with close on-call coverage
4) Schedule full phased rollout across remaining Private clusters during 0200-0500 UTC maintenance windows
5) If any cluster shows reconcile stalls, trigger automated rollback to v3.3.9 and run postmortem remediation
test_plan: Unit tests for migration job timeout and idempotency
Integration test: synthetic cluster with throttled Postgres and simulated nodeagent restarts to validate fallback behavior
E2E validation: helm upgrade -> snapshot parity check -> small write workload -> ensure no reconcile stalls
Chaos testing in staging: random kill operator instance + IO latency injection
monitoring: Dashboards to watch: operator.reconcile.duration (p50/p95/p99), operator.lock.acquisition.latency, nodeagent.ready_percent
Create alert: reconcile_stalled_for_>2m (threshold: >5 namespaces in Warning for 120s)
Query examples: kubectl get events --all-namespaces | grep "reconcile" and grafana link https://grafana.internal/redwood/operator-upgrades
Add log correlation tag: migration_id, tenant_id, cluster_id for quick triage
communications: Incident channel: #inc-operator-upgrade (internal Slack) — used for live coordination

Pressing enterprise customers: SE outreach and weekly status until full rollback or fix verified
